audit.why: Level chart and breakdown.difficulty already correctly frame this as an even lane that favors Seraphine early and Kai'Sa post-item.
Spikes array correctly names lvl3-5 poke window, lvl6 R interrupt, 1st item evolve, and late mobility scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Kai'Sa's R (Supercharger — actually a misnamed slot, her R is Killer Instinct; E is Supercharge) with no real cooldown number, and Kai'Sa is repeatedly misgendered as he/his.
audit.why: Kai'Sa's actual R Killer Instinct is 130/100/70s and her E Supercharge (the reposition+speed ability, upgrading to invisibility) is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s — the field currently invents 'Supercharger' as if it's one ability and gives no digit. Her E Supercharge invisibility window is what creates the flank/reposition threat, and her R is the long-cooldown dash all-in, not a stealth tool.
audit.corrected: Track Kai'Sa's R Killer Instinct (130/100/70s): it's her only dash-in all-in, and Void Seeker (W, 20/18.5/17/15.5/14s) marks you first — engage the instant R is down.

edits.before: His DPS needs fights your charm postpones — poke the notes, sustain the chip, and encore the all-in backward.
edits.after: Her DPS needs fights your charm postpones — poke the notes, sustain the chip, and encore the all-in backward.

edits.before: Out-sustain the stream and charm the one fight he saved for. Keep one eye on Supercharger and one on the wave, in that order.
edits.after: Out-sustain the stream and charm the one fight she saved for. Keep one eye on her R Killer Instinct and one on the wave, in that order.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Duo W-sustain resets the exchange math — shield pre-fight, heal after, and your echoed heal outlasts her plasma chip.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Standing in front of your support feeds her Q Icathian Rain seek priority and lets her stack Plasma off you for free.

edits.before: Commit on Supercharger’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your support’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on R Killer Instinct's cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your support's setup. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Kai'Sa Supercharger: matchup-defining — Her reposition + stealth window — engage in the sixteen seconds after she burns it. Check it before every step-up. - E Beat Drop is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Kai'Sa's R Killer Instinct is 130/100/70s — down after any dash-in, engage while it's on cooldown. - Her E Supercharge is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and upgrades to invisibility on item completion; expect flanks once it's short. - Your E Beat Drop (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-echoed slow push the duo sustains behind — the song shoves and heals in the same measure. Worst wave: a shoved wave against divers with E down — the singer without the root verse. Crash timing: bot waves answer to drake timers — crash for resets and plates, never into a loaded all-in.
edits.after: Best wave: a Q High Note echo builds a slow push you sustain behind — the shield-heal duo makes minion trades free. Worst wave: a shoved wave once Kai'Sa's R is up, since a full-HP dash punishes you for standing on the crash. Crash timing: bot waves answer to drake timers — crash for resets and plates, never with your E Beat Drop down.

edits.before: If Kai'Sa opens the score, reset expectations and respect Supercharger doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with echoed Qs and stay relevant through sustain and charms.
edits.after: If Kai'Sa opens the score, respect her R Killer Instinct threat range doubly — she can dash from 2000-3000 units once ranked up. After a second death, farm behind Q High Note echoes and stay relevant through W sustain and Encore picks.

edits.before: Level 6 is even -- her R dive is countered by your Encore interrupt.
edits.after: Level 6 is even -- her R Killer Instinct dive (130/100/70s CD) is answered by your Encore charm interrupt.

The content layer already correctly says 'R Killer Instinct' in whys/spikes, so this was a full-layer-only error.
